title: Honest Bar
description: Stops a bar chart from exaggerating: when the axis doesn't start at zero it draws a broken-axis mark through the axis and bars, states the distortion ("looks 3×, really 1.09×") with a one-tap Start at 0, tears and labels values past the scale, and reads out exact values on hover and keyboard focus, in pure SVG.
mistakes: y axis not starting at zero
